quote:
There's a reason they don't want you to trade it in or sell it. Starts off extremely slowly, clearly made all these silly normal day mechanics for ONLINE and roleplaying.

author: LastHope17
quote: If you're not a fan don't **** you're fan, maybe. You WILL be disappointed. You can't shape your character. Your words barely hold any impact on any conversation you have. The companions don't have conversations with you like in the past. You can't have conversations with other characters out in the world either. The lore is forgotten so they can do whatever they feel like. Choices from previous games are non-existant. The UI map is confusing. The writing is very poor sometimes, think people just writing about their daily lives and slapping a character to pretend it's something more interesting. The shopping mechanic is terrible. Character creator is partial to only a few body types. Too many colors and the tone and Vibe are poor. The origin stories pick up and you never feel as you are roleplaying them, just getting filled in on things you should have been able to do. Think CP2077 and Jackie.Every aspect about this game is worse than before, except environmental art and sound.

author: LastHope17
quote:
Not great. It has many strange design choices. Most worlds are full of pointless AI generated landscapes. This is the future everyone, AI generation with no soul. Less romancable companion than fallout 4, the ship combat is terrible, there a lot of loading screens everywhere, traveling is just fast travel on a map, they force you to walk places when you should have just landed next to your mission, you need to physically meet characters to talk to them even if it's just to turn something in. Outerworlds at least doesn't feel this silly you can talk to people through your comms all the time. There's no ambience or mystery like FO or Skyrim. It just takes itself really seriously. Then it becomes a joke with game elements that aren't realistic. You can build your ship, but you can start attaching things just for the system to tell you you need an engine out of you flying rank. Does that make sense? I'm not allowed to go buy a V8 Truck in the real world? I don't feel like talking to anyone, no one has anything interesting to say. The factions seem too similar and are all basically just the same thing. Most enemies will be mercs. Remember ME2's only bad guy. It's basically that. You are not voiced, and that can be a very good thing in a game like this, but in this case it's not. You don't get any extra talking points, you barely get the basics like lying and persuade. The days of making you character super intelligent and having extra dialogue or super dumb and extra dialogue is over at bethesda. I can't believe a small dev like obsidian beat you at your own game.

Bethesda choose space and the future for this project, but we are still forced to travel and communicate like were in a wasteland. Shows you how shallow their games are without all the in-between.

TLDR; Just go play outerworlds for a space RPG, or look for a space sim, because this is trying to be both and it exceeds at neither.

author: LastHope17
quote:
You can tell the talent of the game left midway through. After the first fights with Freya and Thor the game never hits the same tempo or intensity. The end fights are very mediocre and rushed not something I expected from such a great and usually polished franchise. They also hint at fighting Ragnorok himself, but they throw that out the window real fast. Fenrir barely makes an impact for what his role should be.

All and all very disappointed with the scale of the big boss fights and the rushed ending. Just Baldurs first fight in GOW 1 created a ravine! That's how crazy the fight was. You'd think a fight against an even stronger opponent like Thor would cause something like that, but no. It starts off strong and when you fight him again it's pathetic in comparison.

author: LastHope17
quote:
This isn't a Avengers game, some critics should realize this. This is closer to the Lego games, but way better to me. Having played the last two Lego hero games on Switch this is 100x better gameplay wise. The formula for the Lego games were; open closed door button, mash boss. That's it that's the whole game. This one is a lot better in that respect and the hero feel more fleshed out.

This is a great game to play with the family.

author: LastHope17
quote:
A game where the devs rather than write a story figured it would be better to make the players the content. Why play a game where all the normal people are the content? What's the point? What happens when there are no players playing? Nothing. That's what. Right now I can go play Fallout 3 a ten year old game and not worry if I can even play it. This will be a game you won't even be able to play in 3-5 years just because the player base of any game falls within that time.

They rely on a old engine and old gameplay that fans dealt with because of the rest of the game was good. Now they rely only on the engine and old gameplay.

This is a shell **** that shouldn't be supported. Look at Red Dead Redemption 2, A gorgeous game with a 60+ single player story mode and an multiplayer component added on later. ADDED ON. This would be an ADD ON in another game, not a full price game on it's own.
